task: Meaning-bearing partial stem copying as a possible human writing rule, distinct from character compression, complete predicate iteration and exact nominal counting.
scope: Live route, bounded topic/search/duplicates/route-check, existing proposal cards and claim-bearing reports only. No new native source/profile/image query, source encoding, statistics, solver, meaning assignment or root-file edit. Historical guesses appearing in the reviewed reports remain historical guesses and are not adopted.
decision: Do not register reciprocal partial copying as a new direction: IDEA785 already pays a related outer operator on a free relational base. Its exact local construction is not a general first-syllable-copy writer, and is not a demonstrated productive native rule. No complete and materially different physical writer was established in this block. This is not an exhaustion claim for partial reduplication.

primary_distinctions.actual_hand_rule: Replace an already present within-word tandem of length3 through8 with a mandatory greatest-legal COPY(n) command, otherwise write the next character. Reset at each source word.
primary_distinctions.retained_limit: Meaning-neutral orthographic compression with an incomplete22-sign carrier. Exact whole-word equality and frequencies remain invariant; the card itself retains1202's source-conditioned exclusion. It is not a semantic partial-reduplication experiment simply because its title says copy. Unreviewed metadata is not proof of an unexecuted source-frequency continuation.

primary_distinctions.actual_hand_rule: Repeat the complete eligible predicate head for explicitly supplied ITER, then write its shared nominal arguments once.
primary_distinctions.retained_limit: The exact whole-group/global-sign-bijection interpretation fails the inherited BB B sequence because its B cannot also begin the required nominal argument. This is an unchanged fixed grammar stop, not a prohibition of semantic copying or of all partial copying. No repair is proposed.

primary_distinctions.actual_hand_rule: Write a learned primitive nominal root n times for an explicitly counted witness set, then an outer property once. The grammar explicitly pays Cartesian ALL and outer NOT.
primary_distinctions.retained_positive: The source-side count/scope lesson was manually coherent, including BB B as nominal arguments. Exact witness size is not population maximality; a separate written negative larger-count assertion can supply that distinction.
primary_distinctions.retained_limit: Complete-root counting, not copied onset inflection. Primitive-root restrictions, lexical meaning/countability, collective versus distributive semantics and an unpaid physical writer remain real costs. It is not refuted merely because947 failed.

primary_distinctions.actual_previous_construction: A locally licensed outer operator combines with the same opaque free transfer relation and requires opposite directed realizations with explicitly shared material and endpoints. Only the bound local application is licensed; the card does not declare a general algorithm copying every stem's onset.
primary_distinctions.retained_limit: Curated not_tested, partial C0: participant identity, realization force and scope are stipulated, the free-base uses remain argument-unbound, and no second derived base establishes productivity. The apparent NOT_ONCE conflict follows from the newly chosen positive head; it is not independent empirical support. None of the historical lexical values is reused here.
primary_distinctions.later_context_limit: 1129 explicitly preserves785's stop. Its full symbolic/event accounts did not select a meaning; the static account buys whole entries and uses zero ordered-part semantic derivations. Its paid hybrid prevents a type-based winner. It does not turn reciprocal onset copying into a confirmed or complete writer.

other_claim_bearing_primaries_read.scope: The fixed repeated-entry family had no eligible compressed two-sided comparison and no family-level transfer capacity. DUP/ECHO/SINGLE stay unchosen. This is not a general rejection of meaningful reduplication; no repeat-marker meaning follows.

A complete repeated base with an outer tail is formally possible and non-unique segmentation is already known. Whether two parses preserve one content is a separate1201 issue. Whole-form ol/olol and daldy/daldaldy remain unassigned formal obligations, not a plural, reciprocal or iterative reading.

concrete_unadopted_teaching_check.purpose: Make the minimum semantic and lexical cost of a partial-copy proposal explicit without relabeling the old reciprocal proposal as new.
concrete_unadopted_teaching_check.operation: For a learned binary predicate root r of length at least2, a proposed single derivation could prepend its first two ordinary teaching letters: copy2(r)+r. For the invented root palu meaning sees(first,second), this gives papalu. The proposed content is R(A,B) AND R(B,A), not two executions, intensity or exact cardinality.

complete_illustrative_strings.readback: Ada sees Bero. No converse assertion follows.
Ada sees Bero and Bero sees Ada. The written names bind the same two argument slots; distinct names do not automatically prove distinct individuals.
It is not the case that both directional seeing relations hold. This is not the conjunction of two negated seeing relations.

concrete_unadopted_teaching_check.first_actual_counterexample: If the learned primitive predicate papalu independently means hears(first,second), the unmarked string papalu simultaneously spells that primitive and copy2(palu)+palu. A preferred parse does not preserve both intended messages. A general rule therefore needs an explicit learned-root restriction, a written distinction or an admitted semantic ambiguity; context alone cannot promise the missing distinction.
concrete_unadopted_teaching_check.cost_of_one_possible_restriction_not_ado: Restrict primitive predicate roots to strings whose first two-letter block is not immediately repeated; allow exactly one onset-copy derivation. Then a derived body starts with two equal blocks, which identifies the operation and leaves the rest as a learned primitive root. Papalu is no longer available as an unrelated primitive. Recursively copying the derived form would be noncanonical. This is a real lexical restriction, not free evidence or an implemented exception.
concrete_unadopted_teaching_check.semantic_counterexample: If R is already symmetric, R(A,B) AND R(B,A) adds no truth-conditional restriction. The construction cannot automatically explain two distinct meanings for every lexical family. If R is an event relation with further participants, their identity, times and quantification must be written or explicitly fixed; the binary lesson does not supply them.
concrete_unadopted_teaching_check.remaining_paid_information: Each root's meaning, spelling and ordered valency are learned. Names preserve exact spelling and need an actual quotation/escape rule. The Roman example's quotes, NOT, spaces and period are visible pedagogic controls but have no paid22-working-sign carrier here. Overwide names, physical continuation and unsupported name characters are not silently solved. No full historical message coverage or native frequency/shape claim is made.
concrete_unadopted_teaching_check.selection_consequence: This hand comparison clarifies a design obligation, but does not justify another native test or corpus writer. A general partial-copy morphology would be a different contract from785's single bound outer operator; completing it solely to restate reciprocal semantics adds no demonstrated new research discriminator here.
